messages:
morgan_ops: Noticing a hiss and a couple seconds of audio drop during the CTO demo at ~15:02. Recorder on record02 shows segment gaps. Live stream still running but audio is slightly ahead of video for ~3s. @riley can you check record02 and OBS?

riley: On it. Switched stream to RTMP fallback to avoid encoder jitter. OBS reports encoder overload on main, backup encoder now on.

devin: I pulled logs from record02: `/var/log/recorderd/record02.log` shows a process OOM kill for `recorderd-worker` at 2026-03-23T15:02:09Z, then auto-restart. Snippet:
```
Mar 23 15:02:09 record02 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4211 (recorderd-wo) score 987
Mar 23 15:02:12 record02 systemd[1]: recorderd.service: restarted successfully
```

infra-bot: infra-alert: node record02 had memory pressure event; pack `recorderd` restarted, no config drift detected. Consider raising `recorderd` memory limit or investigate leak.

morgan_ops: Thanks. Riley, can you start an `rsync` of the segments that were written to /mnt/recordings/tmp to s3 and mark any partial segments? Keep originals retained.

riley: Kicking off `rsync -av --partial --progress /mnt/recordings/tmp/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record02/tmp/` now. ETA ~4m. Will post S3 link when done.

jen (CEO): Don't pause Q&A. Keep fielding questions. We'll answer any missed ones at the end; collect timestamps. Also please make sure legal/comms have the transcript once available.

qa-lyn: I'm scraping the Q&A sheet and chat. Two audience questions appeared at 15:01 and 15:03 which may have been during the drop: "what's the timeline for infra SLA improvements?" and "can we get a written summary of the migration plan?" I'll compile and add to follow-up doc.

stream-monitor: monitor: audio/video sync delta +3.2s at 15:04, packet loss 0.5% increasing to 1.4% across AS-EDGE for 2m window. Captions generator fallback switched to internal ASR cluster.

morgan_ops: Good. Action list: 1) upload spliced segments and raw iso to `s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record02/2026-03-23/` (riley), 2) postmortem draft (morgan_ops), 3) follow-up Q list to leadership (qa-lyn), 4) infra to investigate OOM (infra team). Assigning postmortem to me.

devin: Quick note: I've captured the OOM coredump and attached to /tmp/coredumps/recorderd-4211.dump; will add to the incident ticket.

riley: Upload complete: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-archives/allhands/record02/2026-03-23/ (permissions: team-read). Partial segments are under `/tmp/partial/` with `--partial` markers.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-7421 "record02 recorderd OOM during all-hands" assigned to eng-infra. Priority: P2.

morgan_ops: OK team 10 — thanks for rapid response. Postmortem first draft by EOD, follow-up Q&A summary to Jen and Comms within 1hr. If anyone took local clips they want preserved, paste s3 paths here. :white_check_mark:
